faqs.a:
Before a municipal general contractor's license is granted by the city, the applicant
               shall provide protection to the city against the use of inferior material and performance,
               including damages occurring as a result of willful disregard of this Code and city
               requirements, by posting a one year municipal general contractor's license bond, on
               city-prepared forms, with a warranty period of a minimum of two years, in the principal
               amount of $20,000.00.
(Ord. No.
4749
, § 1, 1-25-2021)
